name: - UEarnPool
fix_description: In claimTeamReward, getUserLevel() determines reward eligibility based on current staking amount which can be inflated via flashloan. Add a time-lock requirement (e.g., must maintain level for N blocks) before claiming, or use snapshot-based level determination instead of instant balance.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step referral/reward abuse requiring creation of 22 helper contracts, building an inviter chain, using a flash swap for temporary capital, and understanding protocol-specific team reward thresholds. While the bug is logical rather than deeply technical, reproducing it needs careful reading of the reward accounting and coordinated multi-contract interactions beyond a simple one-call exploit.
